contaminationNote: Built in September 2026 using current search/model weights. Only sources available by the 2022Q3 cutoff are retained; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.

lanes.purpose: Official China auto and PMI evidence.
lanes.limitations: Focused on MIIT/NBS releases relevant to surfaced Q3 changes.
Issuer evidence is deferred to deep research to avoid company-first discovery bias.

lanes.purpose: Attributed reporting on Sichuan/Chongqing power shortages and manufacturing impact.
lanes.limitations: Historical Reuters pages are accessed through syndication where necessary.
No historical community crawl is used; unavailable is declared explicitly.

sourceItems.title: 2022年8月汽车工业经济运行情况
normalizedClaims: August auto sales +32.1% YoY; NEV sales doubled YoY to 666k and penetration reached 27.9%; auto exports +65% YoY and NEV exports +82.3%.

sourceItems.title: Power Batteries Enter Period of Rapid Development
normalizedClaims: Global power-battery demand was entering a rapid-growth phase as transport electrification accelerated; manufacturers were expanding capacity aggressively.

sourceItems.title: Sichuan orders industrial shutdowns as power shortage intensifies
normalizedClaims: Sichuan ordered industrial users in 19 of 21 cities to halt production for several days as extreme heat and drought reduced hydropower output while residential demand surged. Metals, chemicals and lithium production were affected.
observedChanges: hydropower shortfall becomes physical industrial bottleneck

sourceItems.title: China's Chongqing extends power curbs as drought drags on
normalizedClaims: Chongqing extended factory power curbs as extreme heat and drought persisted; Sichuan normally exports hydropower while coal-fired plants in eastern China were under pressure to compensate.

sourceItems.title: Consumer DRAM Price Decline Expands to 13~18%
normalizedClaims: Q3 consumer DRAM price declines widened to 13-18% as inventory pressure rose and suppliers cut prices aggressively; further declines into Q4 were expected.

sourceItems.title: DRAM Q4 Price Drop Expanded to 13~18%
normalizedClaims: Weak consumer/server demand and high inventories caused DRAM shipments/bit demand to decline in Q3 and led TrendForce to forecast another 13-18% Q4 contract-price drop.

sourceItems.title: NAND Flash Pricing Forecast to Drop 15~20% in 4Q22
normalizedClaims: NAND oversupply intensified, wafer prices had fallen sharply and some supplier product sales were expected to cross into loss territory before year-end.

sourceItems.title: 2022年8月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: August manufacturing PMI was 49.4; production 49.8 and new orders 49.2 remained below 50 amid heat/power and demand disruptions.

sourceItems.title: 2022年9月中国采购经理指数运行情况
normalizedClaims: September manufacturing PMI recovered to 50.1 and production to 51.5, but new orders remained below 50 at 49.8.

eventClusters.statement: China's auto and NEV market accelerated sharply in Q3, with August NEV sales doubling YoY, penetration near 28%, and auto/NEV exports rising strongly; battery demand remained structurally strong.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Volume growth can coexist with raw-material inflation and margin pressure. Company selection requires realized profit/cash conversion, not unit growth alone.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Which A-share OEM/battery name converted extraordinary NEV/export growth into earnings without excessive expectation burden?

eventClusters.statement: Extreme heat and drought caused Sichuan/Chongqing industrial power curtailments as hydropower output fell, while thermal plants elsewhere were asked to compensate, creating a real short-duration power-scarcity shock.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The weather shock may be short-lived. A listed-company winner requires measurable generation/fuel economics and a catalyst that survives normalization.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Did any thermal/power generator have a durable earnings bridge, or was this only a temporary weather shock?

eventClusters.statement: Memory pricing deteriorated sharply through Q3 as inventories rose, DRAM/NAND contract prices fell double digits, and some NAND products approached loss economics.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: This is primarily a negative opportunity/regime signal. Do not bottom-fish until supply response, survival and earnings inflection become measurable.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any defensible turning-point candidate, or should the Skill explicitly choose No selection?

eventClusters.statement: Manufacturing contracted in August and barely returned to expansion in September while new orders remained below 50, showing fragile broad demand despite selected auto growth.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Useful as a cross-thesis regime filter but too broad for direct stock selection.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Use as macro contradiction/timing context rather than standalone long thesis.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff auto price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Auto basket 20d excess -9.88pp and 60d -9.01pp; breadth 0%/0%; adverse. BYD 20d excess -10.42pp and 60d -12.85pp: de_rated. CATL also de_rated.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff power price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Power basket 20d excess +30.17pp and 60d +39.89pp; breadth 100%/100%; favorable but heavily rerated. 华电 60d excess +71.22pp, 华能 +21.54pp, 国电 +26.92pp.

evidenceDocuments.title: Frozen pre-cutoff memory price-regime snapshot
normalizedClaims: Memory basket 20d excess -7.15pp and 60d -15.38pp; breadth 0%/0%; adverse. Both 兆易创新 and 北京君正 were de_rated.
